climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A state that makes wine from European varieties such as Cabernet Sauvignon, Chardonnay, Pinot Noir and Riesling, and from native grapes such as Cynthiana and Muscadine. The multi-state Ozark Mountain AVA reaches into it.
